                    var odoo = {
                        csrf_token: "",
                        debug: "",
                        __session_info__: ,
                    };
                
                
                    // Page blanche impossible : toute erreur au démarrage est affichée à l'écran.
                    window.__comicMobileStartError = function (message) {
                        if (window.__comicMobileStarted || document.querySelector(".o_cm_app")) { return; }
                        var box = document.getElementById("o_cm_boot_error") || document.createElement("pre");
                        box.id = "o_cm_boot_error";
                        box.style.cssText = "white-space:pre-wrap;margin:24px;padding:16px;border-radius:12px;background:#fbe3d3;color:#8f3802;font:13px/1.4 -apple-system,sans-serif";
                        box.textContent = "The app could not start / L'app n'a pas pu démarrer :\n\n" + message;
                        (document.body || document.documentElement).appendChild(box);
                    };
                    window.addEventListener("error", function (ev) {
                        window.__comicMobileStartError((ev.message || "Error") + (ev.filename ? "\n" + ev.filename + ":" + ev.lineno : ""));
                    });
                    window.addEventListener("unhandledrejection", function (ev) {
                        var r = ev.reason || {};
                        window.__comicMobileStartError((r.message || String(r)) + (r.stack ? "\n" + r.stack : ""));
                    });
                    window.setTimeout(function () {
                        var details = "";
                        try {
                            var errors = odoo.loader.findErrors();
                            details = "\n\n" + JSON.stringify(errors, function (key, value) {
                                return value instanceof Set ? Array.from(value) : value;
                            }, 1);
                        } catch (e) {
                            details = "\n\n(no loader diagnostics: " + e.message + ")";
                        }
                        window.__comicMobileStartError("Timeout: the application did not start after 15 s (" + navigator.userAgent + ")" + details);
                    }, 15000);
